subject: history
concept: Understanding how economic systems (trade, currency, taxation) shaped historical societies
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a simple historical trade or taxation scenario
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an economic practice to the historical society that used it
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described economic practice affected a historical society

misconception_flags: cannot connect an economic practice to any specific effect on the society that used it

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
